title: CI scope skips every job on a push that changes only docs/records.md when the head before the push was fully green.
ruling: Owner, page item 830 (pick-records-page-merge-stale), option c, saved on the page at 15:02 CST Nov 14 with no note: let CI scope skip every job on a push that changes only docs/records.md when the head before the push was fully green. The option text carried the line "Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo" and widens:true, so the owner chose the widening knowingly. The grant covers that one case: a push whose only change is docs/records.md, after a head whose run was fully green. Per the option text: ci-scope.sh reads the push's before-head, checks that head's run was fully green and the push changed docs/records.md alone, then sets every job flag false; all-jobs-passed counts those skipped jobs as passed; it changes ci-scope.sh, checks.yml and lint/test_ci_scope.py; it edits the script's own fail-safe list, so it needs review round 3 and the net-value test. The merged tree rests on a green run of the head before the push, read from GitHub, not a run of that tree; the gain is unmeasured. Options a and b are not chosen: the merge tool keeps refusing a ready PR with a stale page, and the ready push of a records page stays. NOTE 17:16 CST Nov 14: the build does less than the ruled "every job", by the coordinator's pick of 17:15 (its own, undoable); the owner has not been told yet; he is told in triage's report. REOPENED 19:48 CST Nov 15 (owner page save, item 857 b "Overrule: the ruling reopens", key taken-830-c-narrowed; as relayed by the coordinator, triage did not read the save): the owner's "every job" pick of 830 c stands as the target. #3426 merged 20:42:52 CST Nov 14 with the narrower gate. The wider build is a guard change (guard rounds apply). Coordinator searched 19:50 CST: #3426, #3441, #3399 closed; #3540, #3556, #2863 open overlaps, none the wider build by title (coordinator's read, unverified by triage). Owner of the build: the consultant (the coordinator started no lane, owner 14:10 rule). Step: ci-scope-skip-every-job-830c.
